sign-in.alt: The Open Chat Interface sign-in page in the dark theme: the instance name, "Sign in to continue to your conversations", email and password fields, a Sign in button, and a note that the instance is invite only.

sign-in-sso.alt: The sign-in page of Example University's instance with a "Continue with Example University SSO" button above the email and password form.

chat-home.alt: The chat home screen: the sidebar with New Chat, search, Projects and the conversation list on the left, and an empty conversation with the message box, model picker, reasoning level, Search and Attach controls.

chat-reasoning-tool-step.alt: A reply to "What are the library's opening hours this week?": a collapsed Reasoning heading, a tool step reading "Searched the web for 'Example University library opening hours' · 5 results", the sources above the answer, and the answer with linked sources.

chat-reasoning-live.alt: A reply still being written: the heading "Thinking…" with a small three-line window under it showing the latest lines of the model's reasoning.

chat-model-picker.alt: The model picker open above the message box: a search box with a capability filter, and a list of models with coloured capability icons for vision, reasoning, effort control, tool calling and PDF reading.

chat-model-details.alt: A model's information card: its name, description, capabilities, provider and limits.

chat-reply-switcher.alt: The latest reply in a conversation with the reply switcher under it reading "‹ 2 / 3 ›", beside Copy, Retry and Export as… buttons.

chat-tool-approval.alt: A reply paused on an approval card for a connector tool, "Create ticket" from the Service Desk connector, showing the exact inputs it will run with and Approve and Deny buttons.

chat-attachment.alt: The message box with a PDF attachment chip, "syllabus-chem101.pdf", above the question "What does section 4 say about late submissions?".

chat-long-conversation.alt: A long conversation with the line "Earlier messages are summarised for the model" expanded to show the summary the model receives: topic, facts and decisions, preferences and open questions.

sidebar-projects.alt: The sidebar with the Projects heading, one project expanded to its five most recent conversations and "Show all (8)", two collapsed projects, then Pinned, Today and Older.

conversation-search.alt: Conversation search for "migr plan": results show each conversation's title with matching lines below and the matched words highlighted; one result is marked Archived and one shows its project's name.

project-conversations.alt: A project page, "CHEM 101 teaching", with New chat in project and the tabs Conversations, Instructions, Files and Settings, open on Conversations.

project-files.alt: The Files tab of a project: four files, three marked "Searchable · n passages" and one scanned PDF marked "No text to search".

project-passages-used.alt: A reply in a project conversation with the note "Searched project files. Used passages from handbook.pdf (2 passages)" expanded by Show passages used: each passage's number, its section heading and its first lines.

project-files-control.alt: The Files control open above the message box in a project conversation: the project's files with a checkbox each, one unticked, and the button reading "Files 3/4".

artifact-writing.alt: A model writing an artifact: the card in the reply reads "Writing Course timeline…" with line and character counts, and the docked panel beside the conversation shows the source as it arrives.

artifact-panel-docked.alt: The artifact panel docked beside the conversation, showing the preview of an HTML page with Preview, Source and Versions tabs and Copy, Download, Full screen and Close buttons.

artifact-full-screen.alt: An SVG diagram artifact in full screen, covering the sidebar and top bar, with Exit full screen in the panel header.

settings-connectors.alt: Settings → Connectors: the Docs service marked Connected with a Disconnect button, and the Service Desk service with a Connect button.

memory-settings.alt: Settings → Memory with Use memory on, an Add a memory field, and four notes, each marked Added by you or Saved by a model, with Edit and Delete.

memory-updated.alt: A reply showing "Memory updated" with the saved note "Teaches first-year chemistry" and an Undo button.

share-dialog.alt: The Share conversation dialog: Share through set to "Latest messages (live)", an optional expiry, Create and copy link, and one existing link with Copy and Revoke.

settings-sharing.alt: Settings → Sharing: "Your shared links" with Revoke all, and a list of links, each with its conversation, Live or Snapshot, Active, Expired or Revoked, the dates, the view count, and Copy and Revoke.

export-menu.alt: The Export as… menu open under a reply, offering Word document, PDF, Presentation and Spreadsheet.

settings-account.alt: Settings → Account: name, email address, role and whether the email is verified, Change Password and View Devices, a note on deleting the account, and the Usage Limits, Keyboard Shortcuts and Need help? cards beside the page.

settings-delete-account.alt: The Delete your account? dialog over Settings → Account: what is deleted and what is kept, a field to type the email address, a password field, and Delete my account.

settings-devices.alt: The Devices dialog: three signed-in sessions with browser and system, a shortened network address, when each signed in and was last active, the current one marked This device, and Sign out all other devices.

settings-customization.alt: Settings → Customization: what to call you, what you do, traits and anything else, then Appearance, Invert Send/New Line Behavior, Wrap Long Code Lines and Open artifacts automatically.

settings-history.alt: Settings → History: Export all conversations and Import from ChatGPT or Claude at the top, Active, Archived and Trash tabs, a title search and a list of conversations with checkboxes.

settings-models.alt: Settings → Models: Defaults with Default model and Default reasoning level, each set to Instance default, and Save defaults; below, Available models with a search box and each model's description and capabilities, the instance default marked.

settings-attachments.alt: Settings → Attachments: storage used against the role's limit, split into chat files, project files and artifacts, and the list of uploaded files.

phone-chat-home.alt: The chat home screen on a phone, with the sidebar closed and the composer's controls behind one button.

phone-sidebar.alt: The sidebar open as a panel on a phone, with projects and conversations.

phone-artifact.alt: An artifact open on a phone, filling the screen, with Preview, Source and Versions and a Close button.

phone-admin-overview.alt: The admin Overview on a phone, with the menu button that opens the admin navigation.

admin-overview.alt: Admin → Overview: the setup checklist with "5 of 6 required steps complete", Set up email delivery marked Needs attention, optional items Not set up, and totals for users, threads, messages and storage below.

admin-providers.alt: Providers & Models, Providers tab: configured providers with their kind, whether a key is set, and Discover models.

admin-models.alt: Providers & Models, Models tab: the default model chooser above the catalogue, and catalogue entries with display names, capabilities, visible roles and an enabled switch.

admin-model-limits.alt: The Edit model dialog for "Research model" with Context window 200,000 and Max output 16,000 among its fields.

admin-embeddings.alt: Providers & Models, Embeddings tab: pgvector shown as enabled, an embeddings model with its vector size and passages embedded, and the Reranking section with its resolved /rerank endpoint.

admin-roles.alt: People → Roles & access for the user role: people with this role, models, feature switches, reasoning levels, rate limits, storage allowance and usage budgets.

admin-roles-tools.alt: The Tools section of a role on Roles & access: built-in tools and connector tools grouped under their connector, each marked read or write, with a switch.

admin-roles-delete-own-account.alt: The Features section of the user role on Roles & access, with the Delete own account switch among the other feature switches.

admin-users.alt: People → Users: a searchable, filterable list of accounts with a role selector on each row.

admin-user-detail.alt: One person's account page: totals, storage, active sessions with address and client, limits with budget progress bars, recent conversation titles and their audit trail.

admin-delete-user.alt: The Delete Jordan Kim? dialog on a person's account page: what is deleted and what is kept, a field to type their email address, and Delete user.

admin-users-bulk-actions.alt: Several accounts selected in the user list, with the bulk action bar offering a role, sign out and ban.

admin-invitations.alt: People → Invitations: pending invitations with their role and expiry, and a form to create one.

admin-authentication.alt: Sign-in & security → Authentication: registration mode, email verification, local sign-in, session length, and the Single sign-on section listing providers.

admin-sso-provider-form.alt: The form for a single sign-on provider: provider type and ID, OIDC settings, default role, allowed email domains, just-in-time provisioning, trust for account linking, role mappings and Require a matching role.

admin-usage-budgets.alt: Models → Usage budgets: budgets with their measure, window, model scope and the roles they apply to.

admin-retention.alt: Data & storage → Retention: conversation, trash, usage history, memory and audit log retention, each showing where its value comes from.

admin-acceptable-use.alt: Sign-in & security → Acceptable use: the published policy version and the editor for a new version.

admin-announcements.alt: Appearance & features → Announcements: a maintenance banner with its audience, whether it can be dismissed, and Re-show.

admin-web-search.alt: Tools & integrations → Web search: the Enable web search switch, the provider choice and maximum results, the Fallback provider section, and Test search and Save changes.

admin-web-search-fallback.alt: Tools & integrations → Web search: the primary provider, then Fallback provider set to SearXNG with its address, and Test search results for both providers.

admin-connectors.alt: Tools & integrations → Connectors: a connector with its server URL, authentication mode, last contact and a list of its tools with read or write and an enabled switch each.

admin-audit-log.alt: Insights → Audit log: search, action filter and date window, with entries showing time, actor, action, target and IP address, and Export.

admin-usage.alt: Insights → Usage: totals, daily volume, a breakdown by model and the heaviest consumers.

admin-usage-deleted-accounts.alt: Insights → Usage, Top consumers: named people and one "Deleted accounts" row ranked among them.

admin-reports.alt: Insights → Reports: a monthly usage summary with its recipients, last send and Send due now.

admin-compliance.alt: Data & storage → Compliance: the export schedule and destination, Include conversation content off, recent runs, and Legal holds with one person on hold.

admin-backups.alt: Data & storage → Backups: Back up automatically on at 03:00 UTC to a separate S3 bucket, the pg_dump version found, retention, and a run history of verified backups.

admin-backups-files.alt: Data & storage → Backups: Copy attachment files on, Files checked after each backup set to a random sample, and a run history showing files copied, already backed up, read back and swept.

admin-webhooks.alt: Tools & integrations → Webhooks: an endpoint receiving backup.run and user.* events, with Send test, Rotate secret and Show deliveries.

admin-health.alt: Data & storage → System health: rows for the database, Redis, model providers, models, background jobs, email delivery, attachment storage, connectors, backups and webhooks, each with its status.

admin-general-settings.alt: Appearance & features → General: the default system prompt, default reasoning level, tool step limit, Summarise long conversations, Editorial diagrams and the feature switches.

admin-storage.alt: Data & storage → Storage: the storage driver, S3 connection and upload policy tabs.

admin-branding.alt: Appearance & features → Branding: the instance name and short name, logo upload, accent colour presets, default theme and the sign-in message.
